senses.gloss:
ITA-9.2.77 yuktarathabastiḥ युक्तरथबस्तिः
Enema practicable even while travelling
A type of enema which can be administered with minimal restrictions on travel and physical activity.

ITA-1.8.3.2 yuktiḥ युक्तिः
Reasoning, understanding causation
The perception of the multiplicity of factors behind a phenomenon or event.

ITA-1.9.4.4.9 yuktiḥ युक्तिः
Logical management, rationale
The quality of being able to intelligently consider circumstances and act on that basis; also considered as one of the methods of investigation and examination.

ITA-2.2.29 yuktikṛta-balam युक्तिकृतबलम्
Acquired strength
Strength or immunity attained by the application of rational means such as rejuvenation therapy.

ITA-9.1.26 yuktivyapāśrayacikitsā, mānuṣīcikitsā युक्तिव्यपाश्रयचिकित्सा, मानुषीचिकित्सा
Structured therapy based on clinical reasoning
A rational and evidence-based therapeutic intervention within the ambit of human intelligence; one of the treatment classifications which has recourse to modalities such as the administration of medicines, diet and other evidence-based approaches to treat a disease.

ITA-5.13.2 yūkā यूका
Head lice infestation
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: itching; wheal-like skin eruptions; papules/ eruptions; nodular swelling.
